To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the performance of the cell is influenced by temperature and C rate of discharge.
the performance of the Li ion cell was affected by temperature and C rate of discharge and the ohmic resistance of the cell increased with decrease in the temperature.
the cell discharge performance is affected by the temperature and C rate of discharge.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the performance of Li ion cells under different C rates and temperature.
the influence of temperature on the electrochemical performance of in house fabricated 30 Ah LFP/MCMB Li ion cell.
the effect of temperature and discharge current rate on the performance of Li ion cells.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a high C rate of discharge and lower temperature would result in a significant loss of cell capability.
the temperature and C rate of discharge are the two major factors that influence the capability of Li ion battery.
the performance of the cell decreases at a higher C rate of discharge and lower temperature.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, the discharge capacity of cell is decreased with increase in C rate of discharge and decrease in temperature.
the cell capacity is reduced at a higher C rate.
the performance of the Li ion cells is affected by the operating temperature and the rate of discharge.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cell performance is highly sensitive to operating temperature, C rate of discharge, and cell configuration.
the performance of Li ion cell can be optimized by controlling the temperature and current density of discharge.
the performance of the Li ion battery is highly dependent on the operating conditions of temperature and C rate of discharge and the temperature has more impact than C rate of discharge.
